source: A load from global memory does not necessarily reach ZXNAME0000XZ. If the requested data is already present in a suitable cache, the request can be satisfied earlier in the hierarchy. Conversely, data from the thread-private local address space can ultimately be backed by the same device memory used for global allocations.[1][3]
zh: 来自全局内存的加载不一定达到 ZXNAME0000XZ。如果所请求的数据已经存在于合适的高速缓存中，则可以在层次结构中较早地满足该请求。相反，来自线程私有本地地址空间的数据最终可以由用于全局分配的相同设备内存支持。[1][3]
